svg.title: The readiness loop
svg.desc: An agent proposes, a fixed harness scores, a ledger records; only a passing model reaches a county brief. Steps: 1. Public data comes in pinned by its hash. 2. An agent proposes a model and the harness scores it. 3. Every score becomes a card in a hash-chained ledger. 4. The loop repeats until the probabilities hold. 5. Only then does a planner get a county brief. Sources: The Readiness Loop README.

text.tspan: Public data comes in pinned by its hash.
An agent proposes a model and the harness scores it.
Every score becomes a card in a hash-chained ledger.
The loop repeats until the probabilities hold.
Only then does a planner get a county brief.
